title: Vietnamese processor, labor shortage (English)
profile_note: Sample producer: furniture and home goods factory, Binh Duong, Vietnam. The regional table does not cover Vietnam and the sample has no labor peer projects, so the answer has limited evidence (the #13 spec's limited-evidence example).
demonstrates: limited evidence (no regional data, no peer examples)

turns.text: We can't find enough workers. Several people left for jobs in the city and we are behind on orders.
It got worse over the last six months. We are short about fifteen workers. We raised wages a little and offered transport, but it hasn't been enough.
